title: Explore one non-record benchmark direction for parameter-golf

operationalConstraints: Use the authoritative task store binding from TASK_STORE_DIR for candidate selection.
Append exploratory evidence records without promoting benchmark-readiness state.
Keep non-record exploration budget bounded to one experiment for this direction.

boundaries: Task store selection decides the next runnable non-record candidate and is the only source of candidate identity.
Execution writes only to authoritative evidence and generated views; no direct mutation of unrelated campaign artifacts.
Readiness signaling stays outside this slice so non-record exploration cannot claim benchmark readiness.
interfaces: Input: task-store candidate payload with lane=non-record-exploration, directionTag, runConfig, and budgetCaps.
Input/Output: measurement evidence projection interface used to append one exploratory evidence record and refresh views.
Output: execution outcome contract carrying taskId, candidateId, reasonCode, and completion timestamp.
risks: Missing or weak lane checks could leak exploration tasks into benchmark-directed lanes.
A readiness claim on exploratory records could incorrectly signal benchmark readiness.
Unbounded retries on one direction can consume exploration budget without adding controlled novelty.
implementationReadyDecisions: Direction is fixed to non-record-new-direction for this FAST-20 slice.
Budget cap is fixed by maxExperimentsPerDirection=1 for this exploratory direction.
Exploration outputs remain evidentiary-only and explicitly avoid benchmark-readiness claims.
